units: <cite ref="Yoma 59a:3">Yoma 59ᵃ</cite> <he>ה׳ ברגל</he> the sprinkling was done in walking around; <he>ה׳ ביד</he> by circular movements of the hand.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 41:1">Pesik. R. s. 41</cite> <he>הַקָּפַת המזבח</he> going around the altar in procession with the Lulab; a. e.

senses.gloss: (ref. to Lev. XIX, 27) shaving the hair of the head all around.
units: <cite ref="Nazir 29a:9">Naz. 29ᵃ</cite> <he>ועביד ה׳</he> and he (the Nazir) may shave &c.
<cite ref="Nazir 29a:9">Ib.</cite> <he>הַקָּפַת כל הראש</he> shaving the entire head, opp. to <he>ה׳ פאה</he> shaving the ends, v. <cite ref="Q00006"><he>פֵּאָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 2:1:5">Y. Sot. II, beg. 17ᵈ</cite> <he>ה׳ נזירות</he> the shaving required by Nazir laws (<cite ref="Numbers 6:18">Num. VI, 18</cite>); a. e.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 10:8:4">Y. Yeb. X, end, 11ᶜ</cite>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 68b">Snh. 68ᵇ</cite>

senses.gloss: debts for merchandise payable at certain seasons (cmp. תְּקוּפָה).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 10:1">Shebi. X, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 8:3">Tosef. ib. VIII, 3</cite> <he>הקפת חנות וכ׳</he> shop-debts are not subject to the law of limitation in the Sabbatical year.—Pl. <he>הַקָּפוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 41:1">Gen. R. s. 41</cite> he came back <he>לפרוע הַקָּפוֹתָיו</he> to pay his debts; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 69:3">Yalk. ib. 69</cite>.
